data.situation:
By half past two on Wednesday, Lin and Maya had a working computer on the equipment table. They opened Monday's puppet recording, but the music began before the narrator finished the first line. Lin moved the two tracks along the same timeline to synchronize the sound. Beside the keyboard lay a card describing two variants of a small audio plugin. The simpler one could integrate with the workshop's existing software. Its main enhancement was a clearer view of where each sound began. The other offered more controls, but Maya was unsure they needed the extra complexity. She played the opening again. This time the music waited for the puppet to turn towards the audience. Lin saved a copy and put the version card beside the headphones. Maya to the workshop teacher:
We have saved the recording with the music and narration synchronized. We chose the simpler variant because it can integrate with the software already on this computer. The clearer timeline is a useful enhancement. Please listen to the opening when you have a moment; we have left the headphones beside the keyboard. Maya’s follow-up to the workshop teacher:
The clearer timeline addresses the problem we heard in the opening: the music entered before the narrator had finished. It lets us see where the tracks begin, which helps us synchronize them without adding controls we do not yet need. The extra complexity of the other variant would be justified if its controls solved a problem that the simpler one could not handle. A longer production might make better use of those controls, provided that the group could operate them and they could integrate with the available software. For this short recording, the simpler variant gives us a workable starting point. Please listen to the saved opening and tell us whether the words remain clear when the music enters. We can reconsider the choice if the next version of the performance creates different demands.

readingBlocks.zh: 周三两点半，林和玛雅在设备桌上拿到了一台能用的电脑。她们打开周一木偶演出的录音，却发现旁白第一句还没说完，音乐就开始了。林在同一条时间轴上移动两条轨道，让声音同步。键盘旁有张卡，介绍一个小型音频插件的两个版本。较简单的版本能与工作室现有的软件配合使用，主要改进是能更清楚地看到每段声音从哪里开始。另一个版本的控制选项更多，但玛雅不确定她们是否需要额外增加这些复杂操作。她又播放了一遍开头。这回音乐等到木偶转向观众时才响起。林另存了一份，把版本说明卡放到耳机旁。

readingBlocks.en:
Maya to the workshop teacher:
We have saved the recording with the music and narration synchronized. We chose the simpler variant because it can integrate with the software already on this computer. The clearer timeline is a useful enhancement. Please listen to the opening when you have a moment; we have left the headphones beside the keyboard.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅给工作室教师的消息：
我们已保存好音乐与旁白同步的录音。我们选了较简单的版本，因为它能与这台电脑上已有的软件配合使用。更清晰的时间轴是个实用的改进。有空时请听听开头，耳机就在键盘旁。

readingBlocks.en:
Maya’s follow-up to the workshop teacher:
The clearer timeline addresses the problem we heard in the opening: the music entered before the narrator had finished. It lets us see where the tracks begin, which helps us synchronize them without adding controls we do not yet need. The extra complexity of the other variant would be justified if its controls solved a problem that the simpler one could not handle. A longer production might make better use of those controls, provided that the group could operate them and they could integrate with the available software. For this short recording, the simpler variant gives us a workable starting point. Please listen to the saved opening and tell us whether the words remain clear when the music enters. We can reconsider the choice if the next version of the performance creates different demands.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅给工作室教师的补充消息：
更清晰的时间轴对应了我们在开头听到的问题：旁白还没说完，音乐就进入了。它让我们看清轨道从哪里开始，有助于同步声音，而不必加入目前用不到的控制选项。如果另一个版本的控制选项能解决简单版本处理不了的问题，额外的复杂操作才有理由采用。更长的演出也许更能用上那些选项，前提是小组能操作它们，而且它们能与可用的软件配合。对这段短录音而言，简单版本是一个可行的起点。请听听保存的开头，告诉我们音乐进入时，台词是否仍然清楚。如果下一版演出的需求改变，我们可以重新考虑选择。

glossary.zh: 使旁白和音乐轨道在时间上同步
glossary.note: synchronize及物动词，本句让旁白和音乐在同一时间轴上配合。
glossary.example: Lin moved the two tracks along the same timeline to synchronize the sound.
glossary.exampleZh: 林在同一条时间轴上移动两条轨道，让声音同步。

externalEvidence.definition: make synchronous and adjust in time or manner

glossary.zh: 软件与已有系统相互融合、兼容运作（integrate with）
glossary.note: integrate with +现有系统；这里主语是插件，不是人融入团队。
glossary.example: The simpler one could integrate with the workshop's existing software.
glossary.exampleZh: 较简单的版本能与工作室现有的软件配合使用。

externalEvidence.label: Collins English Dictionary
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: COBUILD sense 3 expressly includes thing integrates with another to form connected system

glossary.zh: 同类事物中有所不同的版本
glossary.note: variant为软件的不同版本，可数名词。
glossary.example: Beside the keyboard lay a card describing two variants of a small audio plugin.
glossary.exampleZh: 键盘旁有张卡，介绍一个小型音频插件的两个版本。

externalEvidence.definition: something a little different from others of the same type

glossary.zh: 使工具的功能或表现得到改善的改进
glossary.note: enhancement为改进之处；本句指更清晰的时间轴显示。
glossary.example: Its main enhancement was a clearer view of where each sound began.
glossary.exampleZh: 它的主要改进是能更清楚地看到每段声音从哪里开始。

externalEvidence.definition: an improvement that makes something more agreeable

externalEvidence.label: Collins English Dictionary
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: COBUILD improvement in quality/value; supports useful interface improvement

glossary.zh: 一个系统由多部分关系形成的复杂程度
glossary.note: complexity为额外控制之间带来的复杂程度，不是单纯一个困难。
glossary.example: The other offered more controls, but Maya was unsure they needed the extra complexity.
glossary.exampleZh: 另一个版本的控制选项更多，但玛雅不确定她们是否需要额外增加这些复杂操作。

externalEvidence.definition: the quality of being intricate and compounded

retrievalPrompts.cue: Reply to a member who heard the old recording: what did Lin synchronize?
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 回复听过旧录音的组员：林把哪两段声音同步了？
acceptableAnswers: Lin moved the tracks to synchronize the music with the narration.
checks: 自然表达情境中的意思；允许其他正确说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Recommend your chosen variant to the teacher and explain how it integrates with the existing software.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 向老师推荐选定的版本，说明它怎样与现有软件配合。
acceptableAnswers: We chose the simpler variant because it can integrate with the workshop's existing software.
checks: 自然表达情境中的意思；允许其他正确说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Weigh the clearer timeline against extra controls. Which enhancement helps, and what complexity can you avoid?
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 权衡清晰时间轴和更多控制选项：哪个改进有用，哪些复杂操作可以避免？
acceptableAnswers: The clearer timeline is a useful enhancement, and Maya did not think they needed the extra complexity of the other version.
checks: 自然表达情境中的意思；允许其他正确说法

transferPrompt.cue: For a two-minute school interview with one voice track and background music, you compare two variants. The simpler one can integrate with your current software and has a clearer timeline. The other offers more controls, but you have not checked its compatibility or tried those controls. Recommend an initial choice using the information given, and explain one condition under which you would reconsider the other variant.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 为一段两分钟的校园采访处理旁白和配乐，你要比较两个版本。简单版本能与现有软件配合，时间轴也更清晰；另一个版本有更多控制选项，但你还没核对兼容性或试过那些选项。依据这些信息先推荐一种，并说明在什么条件下会重新考虑另一个版本。
acceptableAnswers: I would start with the simpler variant because it can integrate with our software and its clearer timeline could help us align the voice and music. The extra complexity of the other variant might be worthwhile if we needed its controls and confirmed that it worked with our setup.
checks: 用已给出的兼容性和时间轴信息说明初步选择
比较额外控制的可能价值与复杂度，不凭未核对的功能作保证
给出重新考虑另一版本的明确条件，允许其他有依据的选择
允许不同自然说法；不要求照背示例答案
